card.name: FDA adverse event reporting contact text
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short words right after "FDA", "www.fda.gov" or FDA's Adverse Events Reporting System, such as "(" or "/" before the contact or MedWatch text. Also "of" after "incidence rate".

modes.label: After FDA contact
modes.description: An opening bracket or slash right after FDA or www.fda.gov in the report-side-effects line.

modes.label: FDA reporting system name
modes.description: A bracket or the start of "Adverse" in the name of the FDA Adverse Events Reporting System.
modes.example: reports in FDA’s<< Ad>>verse Events Reporting System (AERS)

modes.label: Incidence rate of
modes.description: The word "of" after "estimated incidence rate" in trial results.
modes.example: the estimated incidence rate<< of>> suicidal behavior or ideation among 2

card.plain: It fires on the small joining marks and words in the lines that tell you how to report side effects to the FDA.
